title: Check: placement
description: Five questions on steering Pods towards nodes and each other.

options.text: Requires the node to carry the listed labels

questions.explanation: nodeSelector is a hard requirement and the simplest form. Node affinity is the expressive version.

options.text: The Pod will not schedule unless the rule matches
The scheduler tries to honour it but will place the Pod anyway if it cannot
The Pod is evicted if the rule stops matching
The rule applies only at eviction

questions.explanation: 'Preferred' is a soft weight. 'IgnoredDuringExecution' means the rule is not re-checked once the Pod is running.

questions.prompt: You want two replicas never on the same node. Which do you use?
questions.explanation: Anti-affinity repels; the topologyKey defines what 'same place' means - here, the same node.

options.text: A node label that defines the failure domain

questions.explanation: Common values are kubernetes.io/hostname (per node) and topology.kubernetes.io/zone (per zone).

questions.prompt: Write the command that labels a node named worker-1 with disk=ssd.
questions.explanation: Add `--overwrite` when the label already exists.
